families.name: Blame lands on wrong owner
families.idea: Whoever notices a failure pays for it: provider outages, pauses or a sibling's defect are charged to the unit that saw them.
families.remedy: Classify the cause from code facts and route it to the owner of the cause; the observer keeps its work and recoveries.

families.name: Rewrites replace exact words
families.idea: An LLM or executor rewrite (vision, summary, patch, check literal) can stand in for the owner's or user's exact words.
families.remedy: The user's and owner's words are root agreed text, carried verbatim; literals come only from agreed text.
families.rule: none yet (user-words design, T-119 rule in lanes)

families.name: Two rules disagree
families.idea: Separate parts (planner prompt, reviewer, merge code, matcher) each enforce their own version of a rule, so the loop cannot be won.
families.remedy: One rule per fact in one place; derivable structure is normalised by code, never refused.

families.name: Built for small dreams
families.idea: What works for hello-world holds at size: one plan call, one wave, no contracts, one lock, everything shown in chat.
families.remedy: One machine sized by data: contracts, skeleton wave, progressive waves with steering, bounded views.
families.rule: BLUEPRINT R1, R3, R4, R5, R10

families.name: Proof observes impure state
families.idea: A check's result is trusted without controlling what it ran on: dirty candidates, caches, shared helpers, wrong folder or baseline.
families.remedy: Every check runs hermetically on an exact commit in a disposable checkout; RED removes product only.

families.name: Rig gives false signals
families.idea: A green gate, scripted journey or the dev machine stands in for real use; sleep, hangs, load timing and gate drift hide or fake failures.
families.remedy: Real runs and replayed real answers are the signal; one hermetic gate, load-tolerant, run serially on a machine that cannot sleep.

families.name: Code grows, cleanup later
families.idea: New code may add branches, fixtures, duplicate paths or per-unit cost now and be cleaned or measured later.
families.remedy: Each landing leaves the core simpler: one way to do each thing, no god files, cost measured at the landing.

families.name: Other
families.idea: Product gaps, open questions for Oren and process items with no shared wrong idea.
families.remedy: Handle one by one; move a ticket into a family when a second one shares its idea.

families.name: Coordination before ownership
families.idea: A dream needs peer agreements whenever it spans several product surfaces.
families.remedy: Start with one session when the accepted work fits, and introduce peers only for evidenced ownership needs or explicit staging.

families.name: First-pass proof misses the user boundary
families.idea: A generic check request is enough to catch an omitted user action or a timing-dependent observation.
families.remedy: On fresh WORK, exercise one assigned path through its real entry point and observe its decisive state change.

families.name: Provider sessions disturb desktop
families.idea: Headless provider work can inherit interactive desktop defaults.
families.remedy: Provide noninteractive subprocess defaults and direct builders to headless evidence.
